record.body:
## Interfaces

tests/test_composer_e2e.py runs one module-scoped flow through the installed orchestra and canon entry points: init, idea capture, triage calls, roadmap, effort and position, promotion, roadmap, validate. Nine tests assert R1 to R9.

## Assumptions

One review ran: a major fixture collision (fixed in a separate task) and two minors (the R9 hash was strengthened; the position replay omits the optional phase). Not re-reviewed, at the user's preference.

## Invariants

The test uses temporary state only. Commands match the triage-ideas and init skills. The e2e and packaging modules pass together.

## Conflicts

none
